layout.description: `stack`, the default, is a fixed-row list that renders its own items. `grid` wraps one GridList that has layout="grid" and the vertical orientation, and lays it out in measured rows.

items.description: The rows of a stack layout, as strings or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, and `disabled`. Stack layout only: a grid takes its items on its GridList.

height.description: The stack viewport's block size in px, a finite number greater than 0. Stack layout only.

itemHeight.description: The fixed height of each stack row in px, a finite number greater than 0. Rows are not measured, so content taller than this overflows into the next row. Stack layout only.

overscan.description: The rows mounted above and below the visible window, an integer of 0 or more. For a grid they are whole grid rows.

disabled.description: Disables every stack row and stops `onScroll`. Stack layout only: a grid disables its GridList instead.

children.description: The GridList a grid layout lays out, which must have layout="grid". Required for a grid; a stack renders its own items and takes no children.

minItemWidth.description: Minimum item width in px for a grid, a finite number greater than 0. Default 200.

maxItemWidth.description: Maximum item width in px for a grid, Infinity or a finite number no smaller than `minItemWidth`. Default unbounded, so items stretch to fill their columns.

estimatedItemHeight.description: Estimated height in px of the grid rows that have not mounted yet, a finite number greater than 0. Default 200. Mounted rows take their measured content height.

maxColumns.description: Cap on the number of grid columns, Infinity or an integer greater than 0. Default unbounded. A narrow container shows fewer.

scroll.description: Called when the stack viewport scrolls. It is not called while the Virtualizer is disabled. Stack layout only.

members.name: value
members.description: Consumer data; named Select and ComboBox forms submit the item `id`, not `value`.

MuxUICollectionItem.description: An item a collection renders from data. Other string-keyed fields are consumer data.
